item.title: Putin backs Iran with ‘unwavering support’, congratulates Mojtaba Khamenei on being new Supreme leader
item.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin has reaffirmed Russia’s “unwavering” support for Iran amid rising tensions in West Asia and congratulated Mojtaba Khamenei on becoming the country’s new supreme leader following the death of Ayatollah Ali Khamenei.

item.title: Saudi Arabia cuts oil production as global supply fears rise
item.description: The Strait of Hormuz, a vital route that carries nearly 20% of the world’s seaborne oil trade, has largely shut down amid the escalating conflict in the region. While some Iranian shipments continue to pass through, many vessels from other countries have halted operations due to security concerns.

item.title: Middle East Tensions: CBSE postpones Class 12 board exams in Gulf countries till THIS date; Full story here
item.description: CBSE has postponed Class XII board examinations scheduled between March 12 and March 16 in several Middle East countries due to the prevailing uncertainty in the region. The board said revised dates will be announced after reviewing the situation.

item.title: Kirti Azad slams team India after World Cup win, says ‘the team should feel ashamed’; Know why?
item.description: Former Indian cricketer and politician Kirti Azad stirred controversy after India’s T20 World Cup 2026 win by questioning the practice of linking the trophy with religious places. His social media post sparked a sharp debate among fans online.

item.title: LPG booking period increased from 21 to 25 days to prevent hoarding amid Middle East tensions
item.description: The government has increased the LPG refill booking interval from 21 to 25 days to prevent hoarding and ensure fair distribution as tensions in West Asia affect global energy markets. Officials say domestic households will remain the top priority.

item.title: YouTuber UK07 Rider undergoes surgery after crash; Manager urges fans not to spread rumours
item.description: Popular YouTuber Anurag Dobhal, widely known as UK07 Rider, is undergoing surgery for multiple fractures after a crash on the Delhi-Meerut Expressway. His manager has urged fans to avoid spreading rumours and rely only on official updates.

item.title: PM Modi speaks to RSP chairman, Balendra Shah after massive victory in Nepal elections
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi spoke with Rastriya Swatantra Party leaders Rabi Lamichhane and Balendra Shah after the party’s strong performance in Nepal’s elections, congratulating them and reaffirming India’s commitment to deeper cooperation.

item.title: ‘One Call From PM Modi Could End Iran-Israel Issue’: Former UAE Envoy
item.description: Former UAE Ambassador to India Hussain Hassan Mirza said a single phone call from Prime Minister Narendra Modi to leaders of Iran and Israel could help end the conflict, highlighting the Indian leader’s credibility and influence in the region.

item.title: CM Omar Abdullah hosts dinner for J&K Ranji Trophy Champions; Announces Rs 2 crore reward
item.description: The Chief Minister welcomed the players at the event, which was attended by members of his Cabinet and senior government officials. To recognise their excellent performance, the team was awarded a cash prize of Rs 2 crore.

item.title: Budget Session Live: Opposition ruckus in Lok Sabha; Nishikant Dubey raises major questions to Agriculture Minister
item.description: Amid uproar Nishikant Dubey, a senior MP from Godda, Jharkhand, asked Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan about the government's decisions in the last 12 years in the interest of farmers.
